cards.title: Memory needs a network
cards.question: When does remote memory beat local capacity?
cards.selfCheck: CXL can reduce stranded memory; test latency and utilization gains.
cards.prompt: Extend Nov 26 memory-tiering thesis: remote memory only pays if utilization savings exceed latency and fabric cost. Nov 13 SC26 announcement is technical evidence, not orders. https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-connectivity-ai-infrastructure-supercomputing-2026.html

cards.title: Marvell sells the connection
cards.question: Can MRVL earn more as memory moves?
cards.selfCheck: Switches and CXL controllers add content; test paid deployments.
cards.prompt: Candidate beneficiary, not proven overlooked. Compare Marvell with Astera and optical suppliers; copper and optics may substitute rather than add. https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-connectivity-ai-infrastructure-supercomputing-2026.html https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1039/marvell-bolsters-connectivity-portfolio-with-new-3-2t-protocol-aware-retimer-and-second-generation-1-6t-aec-dsp

cards.title: 2nm optics need a buyer
cards.question: When does a faster demo become revenue?
cards.selfCheck: Sep 20: 400G/lane demo; seek qualification and volume dates.
cards.prompt: September demonstration preceded November 13 SC26 announcement. No fresh commercial proof in last seven days established. Over next 2–6 months seek customer qualification and production commitments. https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-industry-first-2nm-optical-technology-ai-data-center-infrastructure-ecoc-2026.html https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-connectivity-ai-infrastructure-supercomputing-2026.html

cards.title: Twice the speed, twice the sales?
cards.question: Can bandwidth rise faster than supplier revenue?
cards.selfCheck: Faster links can cut port counts; test revenue per delivered terabit.
cards.prompt: Illustrative: doubling link speed while halving ports leaves total bandwidth unchanged; revenue grows only if content per port more than doubles or total bandwidth expands. Current consensus and valuation unverified; no mispricing claim. https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-industry-first-2nm-optical-technology-ai-data-center-infrastructure-ecoc-2026.html

cards.title: MRVL: wait for Dec 1
cards.question: What would turn demos into an earnings bridge?
cards.selfCheck: WAIT: seek volume dates, data-center mix and margin; reject delays.
cards.prompt: Dec 1 earnings confirmed Nov 6. Compare guidance with verified consensus and normalized free cash flow valuation before considering entry. Invalidate incremental fabric thesis if qualification slips or substitution offsets content gains over next two reports. Educational, not personalized advice. https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1041/marvell-technology-inc-announces-conference-call-to-review-third-quarter-of-fiscal-year-2027-financial-results https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-connectivity-ai-infrastructure-supercomputing-2026.html

cards.title: Count net content, not features
cards.question: How can a technical upgrade shrink a market?
cards.selfCheck: Subtract displaced components; test total supplier dollars per rack.
cards.prompt: Compare active copper, pluggable optics and co-packaged optics by reach, power and cost. A new feature is not additive revenue if it replaces an existing sale. https://investor.marvell.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1039/marvell-bolsters-connectivity-portfolio-with-new-3-2t-protocol-aware-retimer-and-second-generation-1-6t-aec-dsp https://www.marvell.com/company/newsroom/marvell-industry-first-2nm-optical-technology-ai-data-center-infrastructure-ecoc-2026.html
